extracted.intended_audience: lawyers, regulatory analysts, policy researchers, and government statisticians tracking/using agency adjudicatory proceedings data
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts and lists the kinds of administrative/adjudicatory proceedings reported by multiple federal agencies (types, statutory citations, and disposition categories) for use in reporting, analysis, or data compilation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition / manner-of-disposition categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Disposition categories reported include: Consent dismissal; Consent order; Moot; Default; Settled; 'Manner of disposition not indicated'; Terminated as a medical... (table notes list many such disposition labels).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table records how proceedings were disposed (examples and counts appear in adjacent columns); notes explain some special counting rules (e.g., cases re-instituted, suspended for reconsideration, not broken down by Part A for FCC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Table notes & data caveats
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes such as 'FCC data for Part A are not broken down as to types of proceedings,' 'Indian probate cases are commenced when...', and other explanatory footnotes affecting counting/interpretation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these explanatory notes when interpreting the counts/types; they affect inclusion rules, counting duplicates, and how final decisions are attributed.
